name: DatePicker
statusNote: Shipped as @fluentui/react-datepicker-compat, a v8-derived compat package over the v9 Input and Calendar; its API predates the v9 slot conventions.
summary: A form field for one date: an Input showing the formatted date with a calendar icon, and a Calendar that pops up under it. Use it where a date belongs in a form; use calendar alone where the grid is the content, and time-picker for a time.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The selected date; null for none when the caller controls it.

inputs.name: onSelectDate
inputs.description: Runs with the picked date, or null when the text is cleared or fails to parse.

inputs.name: placeholder
inputs.description: The input's placeholder while no date is set.

inputs.name: formatDate
inputs.description: Formats the selected date for the input; the default is the platform's date string.

inputs.name: parseDateFromString
inputs.description: Parses typed text to a date when allowTextInput is set; the default is the platform's parser.

inputs.name: allowTextInput
inputs.description: Lets the date be typed; otherwise the input is read-only and only the calendar sets it.

inputs.name: openOnClick
inputs.description: Opens the calendar when the input is clicked.

inputs.name: disableAutoFocus
inputs.description: Stops the calendar opening when the input takes focus; the types warn this is an accessibility violation.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Controls the calendar's visibility from outside.

inputs.name: defaultOpen
inputs.description: The initial visibility when the picker controls itself.

inputs.name: onOpenChange
inputs.description: Runs when the calendar opens or closes, with the new value.

inputs.name: onValidationResult
inputs.description: Runs after the text is validated on blur, Enter or close, with no error or one of invalid-input, out-of-bounds and required-input.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Makes an empty value a required-input validation error; a wrapping Field sets it.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables the input and never opens the calendar.

inputs.name: underlined
inputs.description: Draws the input in its underline appearance.

inputs.name: borderless
inputs.description: Draws the input in its filled-lighter appearance, with no border.

inputs.name: inlinePopup
inputs.description: Lays the popup out in place under the input instead of in a portal.

inputs.name: positioning
inputs.description: Where the popup sits relative to the input, aligned to its start by default; it flips to stay in the viewport.

inputs.name: today
inputs.description: The date the calendar marks as today.

inputs.name: initialPickerDate
inputs.description: The date the calendar opens on when nothing is selected.

inputs.name: minDate
inputs.description: The earliest allowed date; earlier typed dates are out-of-bounds.

inputs.name: maxDate
inputs.description: The latest allowed date; later typed dates are out-of-bounds.

inputs.name: isMonthPickerVisible
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar: shows the month picker beside the day grid.

inputs.name: showMonthPickerAsOverlay
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar: the month picker overlays the day grid.

inputs.name: showGoToToday
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar: shows the go-to-today button.

inputs.name: showWeekNumbers
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar: shows week numbers.

inputs.name: showCloseButton
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar: shows a close button in the day header.

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar.

inputs.name: firstWeekOfYear
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar; note the default differs from the calendar's own.

inputs.name: highlightCurrentMonth
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar.

inputs.name: highlightSelectedMonth
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar.

inputs.name: allFocusable
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar: disabled days take focus.

inputs.name: strings
inputs.description: The calendar's strings; the picker's defaults reword the navigation and close labels (go to previous month, close date picker) and add the three validation messages.

inputs.name: dateTimeFormatter
inputs.description: Passed to the calendar.

inputs.name: calendar
inputs.description: Further Calendar props.

inputs.name: popupSurface
inputs.description: The popup's surface element.

anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.description: The Input: the picker's field, positioned relative so an inline popup can hang under it, with a pointer cursor over it and its text.

anatomy.name: Calendar icon
anatomy.description: The input's contentAfter slot holding the calendar-month icon, a button that opens the calendar.

anatomy.name: Popup surface
anatomy.description: The floating surface the calendar sits in, present only while open.

anatomy.name: Calendar
anatomy.description: The Calendar inside the surface, opened on the selected date or initialPickerDate.

variants.description: The Input's underline appearance, from the underlined prop.
The Input's filled-lighter appearance, from the borderless prop; underlined wins when both are set.
The input shows the formatted date and cannot be typed in; the calendar sets the value.
With allowTextInput the date can be typed and is parsed and validated on blur, Enter or close.
The surface floats in a portal, positioned below the input's start.
With inlinePopup the surface lays out in place under the input, above later siblings.

layout.text: The field is the Input component in the chosen appearance with the calendar-month icon as contentAfter; its size, padding and colours are input.json's.

The popup surface is an inline-flex box filling colorNeutralBackground1 with colorNeutralForeground1 body1 text, a 1px colorTransparentStroke border, borderRadiusMedium corners and shadow16, sized by the calendar inside it.
The surface is positioned below the input aligned to its start unless positioning says otherwise; inline, it stacks above its later siblings.

states.text: Rest is the Input's rest look with a pointer cursor over the field and its text.
While open the surface shows with the calendar focused on the selected day; the input reports expanded.
Disabled is the Input's disabled look with the default cursor over the field and its text; the calendar never opens.
A validation error is reported to onValidationResult (invalid-input, out-of-bounds or required-input, with default messages) and a wrapping Field shows it; the picker itself draws nothing for it.

behaviour.text: The calendar opens when the input takes focus (unless disableAutoFocus), when the input is clicked (openOnClick), when the calendar icon is clicked, and on ArrowDown or Enter in the input; a disabled picker never opens.
Picking a day in the calendar sets the value, formats it into the input with formatDate, calls onSelectDate, closes the popup and returns focus to the input.
Escape, the calendar's close button and a click outside close the popup; with allowTextInput, closing also validates the typed text.

With allowTextInput, typed text is parsed with parseDateFromString on blur, Enter and close: an unparsable string is invalid-input, a date before minDate or after maxDate is out-of-bounds, and an empty required field is required-input; a valid date becomes the value.
Clicking the calendar icon toggles the popup; with allowTextInput it first commits the typed text.

keyboard: Tab moves focus to the input, which opens the calendar unless disableAutoFocus
ArrowDown and Enter open the calendar; Enter with allowTextInput commits the text
Escape closes the calendar and returns focus to the input
inside the calendar the arrow keys, Home, End, PageUp and PageDown move and Enter picks
semantics: the input is role combobox with aria-haspopup dialog and aria-expanded, and aria-controls the surface while open
the calendar icon is role button labelled by the input's label, with aria-expanded
the surface is a modal dialog labelled Calendar
the input is read-only unless allowTextInput
validation errors reach onValidationResult, and a wrapping Field's message shows them

notes.text: borderless does not remove the border of the outline appearance; it switches the Input to filled-lighter, and underlined wins over it.
The picker's firstWeekOfYear default is firstFullWeek where the calendar's is firstDay, so the same setup numbers weeks differently through the two APIs.

The surface border is a 1px constant; the popup's below-start placement is the positioning hook's default. The hook file useDatePicker.tsx (open, validation and slot wiring) is not citable by the kit's source pattern, so those rules cite the types.
The default formatDate and parseDateFromString are the platform's Date string and Date.parse, as the types document; the design site describes the field as a date input with a calendar affordance.
